findings.title: wrangler depends on sharp <0.35.4 (high CVE: GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c)
findings.detail: wrangler ^4.37.0 (installed: 4.37.0) pulls in miniflare which depends on sharp <0.35.4. sharp <0.35.4 contains heap-buffer-overflow vulnerabilities in libheif (GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497, GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545). The full chain is wrangler (4.16.0–4.130.0) → miniflare → sharp <0.35.4. Affected: package.json devDependencies.wrangler.
findings.suggested_fix: Bump wrangler from ^4.37.0 to ^4.136.3 in package.json and run npm install to update package-lock.json
